decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (1495-01/FP and 1495-02/FP received 21.03.12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the use of the ground floor unit known as 210 Great West Road.
description: Extension of planning permission 0505/210/P11 dated 27/8/2009 for the demolition of existing garage and erection of a new single storey outbuilding for use for storage and vehicle parking
